title: California Statewide Crop Mapping
description: Official field boundaries for 438,790 agricultural parcels across California, derived from the California Department of Water Resources Statewide Crop Mapping program. The dataset includes crop type codes and names for the 2022 provisional survey year, distributed as a fiboa-compliant GeoParquet file.

## README.md
# Field boundaries for CA SCM

Provides 438790 official field boundaries from CA SCM.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from California Department of Water Resources.

- **Source Data Provider:** [California Department of Water Resources](https://water.ca.gov/)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **License:** CC-0
- **Projection:** EPSG:4269 (NAD83)

---

- [Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/us-ca-scm/us_ca_scm.parquet)
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/us-ca-scm/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/us-ca-scm/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/us-ca-scm/us_ca_scm.pmtiles)

## Columns

| Property               | **Data Type** | Description                          |
|------------------------|---------------|--------------------------------------|
| id                     | string        | Identifier                           |
| crop:code              | string        | Crop code from original dataset      |
| crop:name              | string        | Crop name from original dataset      |
| admin_level_2          | string        | Country                              |
| determination_datetime | timestamp     |                                      |
| crop:code_list         | string        | Crop code list from original dataset |

## Lineage

- Data downloaded on 2024-11-22 from https://data.cnra.ca.gov/dataset/6c3d65e3-35bb-49e1-a51e-49d5a2cf09a9/resource/f38d3f6f-dcf1-4553-9f07-4f381d494320/download/i15_crop_mapping_2022_provisional_gdb.zip .
- Converted to GeoParquet using [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli), version 0.8.0
